Use WPForms With Your Favorite AI

Connect your WordPress site and WPForms to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more. Ask them to find submissions, build forms, or edit fields in plain English. No copy-pasting, no exports. Connect them with the free WPVibe.ai plugin.

Everything WPForms Can Do With AI

View Abilities API Documentation

Forms
  • Create a brand new form using plain English
  • Update form settings and submit button text
  • Get a form's full configuration, including every field

Fields
  • Add a field to an existing form
  • Update an existing field (label, required, options…)
  • Discover which field types are available

Entries

Pro
  • Browse entries for any form, with pagination
  • Search entries by date range, field value & status
  • Get a single entry's full details
Notifications

Notifications are emails sent when a form is submitted. By default, these emails include entry details. For setup and customization options, including a video overview, please see our tutorial.

After saving these settings, be sure to test a form submission. This lets you see how emails will look, and to ensure that they are delivered successfully.
